systems.title: Pipe systems and sanitaryware for Iraq’s buildings and infrastructure.
systems.lead: Since 1975, AtlasPlast has supplied water supply, drainage and sanitary systems from leading international manufacturers to contractors, installers and national projects in every governorate.

history.lead: From construction materials in 1975 to the first Atlas showroom in 1990, the first exclusive international agency in 2004 and a regional office in Saudi Arabia in 2025.

brands.lead: Exclusive and authorised agencies for manufacturers from Switzerland, Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Italy, the Czech Republic, Serbia, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Egypt.

statement.title: A distributor built on stock, reach and technical knowledge.
statement.body1: AtlasPlast holds commercial agencies for international manufacturers of piping, drainage, sanitaryware and pumps, many of them exclusive in Iraq. We supply the materials and the technical support behind housing, infrastructure and government developments.
statement.body2: Our warehouses in Baghdad, Basra, Erbil, Duhok and Zakho are planned to cover the country’s demand for nine months, so contractors and installers are supplied without interruption.
statement.projects: Hundreds of projects completed with AtlasPlast products.

index.title: Complete systems, from the water main to the tap.
index.intro: Our range is organised by what you are building: drinking water, drainage and grey water, water heating, networks, galvanized fittings, bathrooms, tiles, pumping and installation. Every product line comes from a manufacturer AtlasPlast represents, with stock held in Iraq.

labels.count: {count, plural, one {# product line} other {# product lines}}
labels.enquireText: Our sales and technical teams advise on selection, quantities and delivery for projects of every size.

waterSupply.name: Water supply pipes
waterSupply.text: PP-R, PP-RCT and multilayer pipes for hot, cold and drinking water, including UV-resistant lines for exposed runs.
waterSupply.intro: Pressure pipe systems for hot and cold water inside buildings. The range covers PP-R and PP-RCT pipes and fittings, five-layer ML5 pipes for added strength, and UV-resistant systems for exposed and outdoor installation.

drainage.name: Drainage and grey water
drainage.text: PVC-U, low-noise PP and KG systems for basins, showers and kitchens, soil stacks and buried sewers.
drainage.intro: Drainage for the water that leaves a building: grey water from basins, showers and kitchens, soil stacks and buried sewer lines. Choose from PVC-U pipes, low-noise PP systems rated by sound level, and KG pipes for underground runs.

waterHeaters.name: Water heaters
waterHeaters.text: Aquahot electric water heaters from Saudi Ceramics, from 10 to 300 litres.
waterHeaters.intro: Electric storage water heaters. Aquahot heaters from Saudi Ceramics come in vertical and horizontal models, with enamelled tanks, a two-valve system rated at 8.5 bar and Italian-made electrical components.

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure networks
infrastructure.text: PE100 and U-PVC pressure pipes with compression, electrofusion and fabricated fittings up to Ø 2000 mm.
infrastructure.intro: Pressure pipe systems for water mains, city networks and project infrastructure: PE100 pipes in straight lengths and coils, U-PVC pressure pipes up to Ø 400 mm, compression fittings for drinking water and pressurised waste water, and PE fittings up to Ø 2000 mm.

galvanizedFittings.name: Galvanized fittings
galvanizedFittings.text: Georg Fischer threaded fittings in galvanized malleable iron, made in Austria.
galvanizedFittings.intro: Threaded pipe fittings in galvanized malleable cast iron from Georg Fischer, produced in Austria to EN 10242.

sanitaryware.name: Sanitaryware and cisterns
sanitaryware.text: Vitreous china, bathroom furniture, concealed cisterns and pre-wall frames.
sanitaryware.intro: Everything visible in a finished bathroom and the frames behind the wall: vitreous china WCs, basins, urinals and bidets, moisture-resistant bathroom furniture, and concealed cisterns with dual-flush 3/6 litre systems.

tiles.name: Ceramic and porcelain tiles
tiles.text: Porcelain and ceramic wall and floor tiles from Saudi Ceramics, for indoor, outdoor and wet areas.
tiles.intro: Porcelain and ceramic tiles from Saudi Ceramics for walls and floors, indoors and out, in wet areas and commercial spaces. Porcelain comes in sizes up to 120×60 cm, with water absorption of 0.5% or less and anti-slip models rated R9 to R11.

pumps.name: Pumps and pressure
pumps.text: DAB circulators, booster sets, self-priming, submersible and drainage pumps.
pumps.intro: Pumping for buildings and water systems from DAB of Italy: circulators, in-line and centrifugal pumps, multistage and self-priming units, submersible, sewage and drainage pumps, lifting stations, pressure units and controls.

faucetsValves.name: Faucets and valves
faucetsValves.text: Basin, kitchen, shower and sensor mixers, built-in valves and shower sets, with brass angle and ball valves.
faucetsValves.intro: Mixers and valves for bathrooms, kitchens and laundries: basin, kitchen, shower and bidet mixers including sensor series, built-in valves and shower sets, and brass angle valves, ball valves and faucet sets.

installationTools.name: Installation tools and fixings
installationTools.text: Welding machines for PP-R and PE, pipe clamps, profiles, chemical anchors and sealants.
installationTools.intro: The equipment that completes an installation: welding machines for PE and PP pipes up to Ø 1200 mm, pipe clamps, profiles and consoles, chemical anchors, pipe sealants and adhesives.

poloPolymutan.text: Hot and cold water pipe system in PP-R 80, resistant to high temperatures and mechanical wear.

poloEcosan.text: PP-R system for healthy, corrosion-free drinking water, for drinking-water and industrial applications.

poloUv.text: The first UV-resistant pipe system: POLO-UV ML5 fibre pipes with PP-R fittings, for exposed installations and irrigation.

poloPolymutanMl5.text: Five-layer pipe combining PP-R 80, an HPCE compound and PP-RCT for added strength.

polymutan.text: PP-R and PP-RCT pipes and fittings for hot and cold water, in pressure classes PN 10 to PN 25.

polymeltUv.text: Pipe with a black UV-resistant outer layer and fibre layers, for installations exposed to sunlight.

aquasystem.text: PP-R pipe system for hot and cold water in buildings.

aquapa.text: PP-R pipes and fittings for hot and cold water.

baenningerPpr.text: PP-R and PP-RCT pipes for hot and cold water. AtlasPlast is the exclusive Bänninger agent for central and southern Iraq.

poloEgy.text: PP-R pipes for hot and cold water.

boroug.text: White PVC-U pipes joined with solvent cement, resistant across a pH range of about 2 to 13.

silentaPremium.text: Sound-insulated drainage pipes and fittings for buildings, supplied with or without sockets.

silenta3a.text: Socketed low-noise drainage system for building waste water.

poloKalNg.text: Low-noise drainage with EPDM seals, chemically resistant from pH 2 to 13.

poloKal3s.text: Sound-insulated drainage with sockets and built-in EPDM seals.

aquaSilent.text: Socketed low-noise PP drainage for building waste water.

skolanSafe.text: Mineral-filled PP drainage with high sound insulation, chemically resistant from pH 2 to 12.

htSafe.text: Mineral-filled PP drainage pipes for waste water inside buildings.

kgSystem.text: Co-extruded PVC-U sewer pipes for buried drainage, in stiffness classes SN 4, 8 and 10.

aquahot.text: Electric water heaters in vertical and horizontal models, with enamelled tanks and Italian-made electrical components.

pimtasPe100.name: PE100 pipe and fittings
pimtasPe100.text: Polyethylene pressure pipes in straight lengths and 100 m coils, with or without sockets.

pimtasUpvc.name: U-PVC pressure pipe
pimtasUpvc.text: Pressure pipes up to Ø 400 mm, with socket, plain-end or O-ring joints.

pimtasCompression.name: Compression fittings
pimtasCompression.text: For drinking water and pressurised waste water, above ground and underground.

turanPeFittings.name: PE fittings
turanPeFittings.text: Injection-moulded, electrofusion and fabricated PE fittings and kits up to Ø 2000 mm.

turanPe100.name: PE100 pipe
turanPe100.text: Polyethylene pressure pipe in lengths and 100 m coils.

gfPe100.text: Polyethylene pressure pipe up to Ø 355 mm in SDR 9 and SDR 11.

oryx.name: Oryx sanitaryware
oryx.text: Fully glazed vitreous WCs, basins, urinals and bidets, with rimless, soft-close, anti-bacterial and water-saving designs.

saudiPorcelain.name: Porcelain tiles
saudiPorcelain.text: Rectified and non-rectified porcelain in glossy, matt, polished and semi-polished finishes, with anti-slip models.

saudiCeramic.name: Ceramic tiles
saudiCeramic.text: Wall and floor tiles for indoor, outdoor and wet areas and commercial spaces, in glossy, matt, polished, rustic and anti-slip finishes.

quarterbathSanitary.name: Sanitaryware
quarterbathSanitary.text: Vitreous WCs, basins, urinals and bidets with matching accessories.

quarterbathFurniture.name: Bathroom furniture
quarterbathFurniture.text: Moisture-resistant MDF with fully sealed edges, anti-fungal and anti-bacterial coating and soft-close storage.

quarterbathCistern.name: Concealed cistern
quarterbathCistern.text: Powder-coated steel frame with adjustable height and depth and a sound insulation pad.

wisaPrewall.name: Pre-wall elements and built-in cisterns
wisaPrewall.text: Pneumatic and mechanical concealed cisterns for wall-hung WCs with quiet fill valves, from WISA, owned by Fluidmaster.

dab.name: DAB pumps
dab.text: Circulators, in-line and centrifugal pumps, multistage and self-priming units, submersible, sewage and drainage pumps, lifting stations and pressure units.

kas.name: KAS faucets
kas.text: Basin, kitchen, wall-mounted, shower, bidet and industrial kitchen mixers, with a sensor series and spare parts available.

shield.name: Valves and faucets
shield.text: Brass angle valves, ball valves, faucet sets and accessories for laundries, bathrooms and kitchens.

topsanFaucets.name: Topsan faucets
topsanFaucets.text: Mixers with 35 and 40 mm cartridges, classic, single and industrial faucets, made in Istanbul since 1979.

topsanShower.name: Built-in valves, shower sets and valves
topsanShower.text: Built-in (concealed) valves, robot, sliding and articulated shower sets, shattaf sets, and valves.

turanWelding.name: Butt welding machines
turanWelding.text: Manual and automatic machines for PE and PP pipes from Ø 20 to 1200 mm.

candan.name: Welding machines
candan.text: Pipe welding machines with adjustable temperature, in several power ratings, with spare parts.

ascelik.name: Clamps and profiles
ascelik.text: Pipe clamps, profiles and consoles in malleable iron, ductile iron and steel for plumbing, HVAC and industrial piping.

guarriChemicals.name: Chemical anchors and sealants
guarriChemicals.text: Polyester and vinyl ester chemical anchors, pipe sealants and super glue.

kasPpr.text: PPR pipes and fittings for hot and cold water.

gfMalleable.name: Galvanized malleable iron fittings
gfMalleable.text: Threaded fittings in galvanized malleable cast iron to EN 10242.

baenningerPe.text: PE and PVC-U pipe systems from Ø 8 to 1000 mm. AtlasPlast is the exclusive Bänninger agent for central and southern Iraq.

About.title: Since 1975, supplying the systems Iraq builds with.
About.intro: AtlasPlast, trading as Ufuq Al-Atlas Ltd., began supplying construction materials in 1975 and opened its first showroom in Baghdad in 1990. Today it represents international manufacturers of piping, drainage, sanitaryware and pumps across Iraq.

purpose.vision: To make AtlasPlast products the first choice of consumers in Iraq, for water, drainage and sanitaryware.
purpose.mission: To supply Iraq with durable, high-quality products for water and sewage networks, and sanitaryware that is functional and well designed.

values.respect: Respect for customers, employees and the environment

Board.title: A message from our Chairman

message.p1: Since its founding, AtlasPlast has grown into a leading provider of piping and sanitary solutions in Iraq, driven by excellence, innovation, and trust. Today, we continue to expand across the Middle East and North Africa.
message.p2: At AtlasPlast, we believe that sustainable growth is built on vision, dedication, and trust. From our early beginnings to becoming a key player in Iraq’s infrastructure and sanitary ware sector, our mission has always been to serve communities, empower professionals, and contribute to building a better future.
message.p3: Our continued success is driven by innovation, reliable service, and long-standing partnerships. As we expand across the region, we remain committed to the values that have guided us for over four decades—excellence, integrity, and progress.
message.p4: Our achievements are not just the result of strategy and vision, but of the commitment and trust of the people who make up the AtlasPlast family.

Board.quote: At AtlasPlast, we believe that sustainable growth is built on vision, dedication, and trust.
